_identityRule: A distinct symbol is a distinct (fully-qualified name, parameter signature, linkage) triple. A declaration and its definition are ONE symbol. Two overloads are TWO. A static function in a.cpp and one in b.cpp sharing a spelling are TWO.
_gradedBy: direct reading of the C++, not by any field the extractor produced

distinctSymbols.shape: P2 free function decl+def, one symbol
P1 overload B — DISTINCT from overload A
P4 same leaf name as alpha::Widget, DIFFERENT symbol
P6 declared twice, defined nowhere in this corpus — ONE symbol
P5 static twin B — DISTINCT from twin A

_notes: 16 distinct symbols across 3 files. A carrier with sound identity produces 16 groups, each holding every site of exactly one symbol.
The two hardest pairs are deliberate: alpha::clamp(int) vs alpha::clamp(double) must NOT merge, and alpha::Widget::render() vs beta::Widget::render() must NOT merge.
The two hardest joins are also deliberate: each decl/def pair must NOT fork.
